1a:T110f,{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What is an ITIN and who needs one?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"An ITIN (Individual Taxpayer Identification Number) is a tax processing number issued by the IRS for individuals who are required to have a U.S. taxpayer identification number but do not have, and are not eligible to obtain, a Social Security Number. Non-US citizens who earn US income, open US bank accounts, form LLCs, or sell on Amazon need an ITIN."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How much does it cost to apply for an ITIN with itin.so?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Our standard ITIN application service costs $297 flat fee with no hidden charges. This includes W-7 form preparation, document review by an IRS-authorized CAA, application submission to the IRS, and email status updates. Our express service is $397 and includes priority queue processing and WhatsApp support."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How long does the ITIN application process take?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"We prepare your ITIN application within 7 business days. Once submitted to the IRS, processing typically takes 6-11 weeks. Our express service prepares your application in 2-3 business days.
